## RE:volution Mod v1.3.1

v1.3.1 establishes the architecture baseline for future world, realm, location and fixed-mob changes while preserving the existing gameplay and persistence contracts.

### Added
- An explicit server composition root with constructor-injected services and repository ports.
- Separate definition, runtime state, persistence projection, application service, transport, Forge-adapter and client responsibilities.
- Dedicated client lifecycle, network and input adapter packages with narrow UI/bootstrap boundaries instead of wider public internals.
- Architecture guards, negative guard tests and mirrored test packages.
- Mongo document/encoding contracts, byte goldens for all eight registered packet DTOs, resource/payment/combat service checks and whitelist migration tests.
- An architecture contract and runtime checklist for future changes.

### Fixed
- Business operations no longer live inside request packet DTOs and handlers.
- Shared Mongo ownership replaces independent clients in static managers; shutdown releases server state, listeners, request cooldowns and the connection.
- Forge mob/player event adapters are grouped by domain instead of remaining in broad package roots.
- Client registration and initialization are isolated from common/server classes.
- Builds no longer depend on a committed absolute Windows JDK path.
- GUI rendering is compatible with early Java 8 clients such as Java 8u51: typed NIO buffer mutations are dispatched through `java.nio.Buffer`, with a production-wide regression guard preventing the incompatible bytecode pattern from returning.

### Other
- Forge 1.12.2 / 14.23.5.2859, Java 8, gameplay formulas, economy, legacy action strings, discriminator IDs 0-7, channel `revolution:main`, Mongo schema and optional-client protocol support are preserved.
- Vanilla/no-mod login was explicitly removed from the v1.3.1 runtime acceptance checklist; this does not change the preserved optional-client protocol behavior.
- Resource-pack mechanics, namespace, paths, fallback and reload are unchanged.
- Realms, locations, fixed-mob progression and new reward distribution mechanics are not implemented here.
- The unused `ServerInit` bootstrap and unregistered `BalancePacket` were removed; registered balance packet ID 1 remains unchanged.
- Runtime acceptance passed for the final feature head, including C/O GUI, admin/whitelist, rune purchase/enhancement/awakening/payment/save, x100/autoclicker, combat effects, managed mobs/rewards, unload/load behavior and resource-pack reload. The exact merged `develop` commit also passed post-merge CI.

### Download
Download `RE-volution-1.3.1.jar` and use the same version on the server and modded clients. Rune textures continue to ship separately in the [RE:volution Resource Pack](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack).

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1
